author: Bobby Grayson
description: Cowork spawns multiple agents that may run for hours/days. MCP server lifetime = conversation lifetime. If the MCP server process dies and restarts, active_session_id is lost (it's in-process memory). Need to handle: 1) server restart mid-conversation, 2) multiple cowork agents sharing one project's graph, 3) long gaps between tool calls.
title: Question: does session model work for long-running cowork under a project?
